notes: מִשָּׁם → *thence* heads on שָׁם as the morpheme carrying the lexeme; עַל־כֵּן → *therefore* has no morpheme carrying content the other lacks, so it heads on the governing עַל (rules 23, 30).
The demonstrative takes the phrase's one determiner *this* and both articles are unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
